question:
Which top 20 driver created the shortest lap time ever record in a Formula_1 race? Please give them full names.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: shortest lap time refers to MIN(time); the time format for the shortest lap time is 'MM:SS.mmm' or 'M:SS.mmm'; full name of the driver refers to forename, surname

prediction.sql:

FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034

LIMIT 20
